+---
+## What
+
+`swift test` does not compile at `652a65d`. `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/InlineSettleGraceTests.swift` reads `envelope.detail` on a `PendingRunEnvelope`, but `Package.resolved` pins `FoundationModelsRouter` at `efe0147`, and that revision has no `detail` member. The commit `b6a3f97` (runcode: answer a short snippet with its own result) says the change needs the Router change on the router's `pool` branch. The sibling checkout `../FoundationModelsRouter` on `main` at `7e82607` has `public let detail: String?` on `PendingRunEnvelope`.
+
+Update the Router pin in `Package.resolved` to a revision that has `PendingRunEnvelope.detail`, then run `swift test`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` compiles the test target.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes in full.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Run `swift test`; expect zero failures. #operation-tools
